lines.say: Why do your knees crack when you squat?
Your joints sit in a slippery fluid.
When the joint opens up, the pressure drops, and a gas bubble forms.
In scanner videos, that bubble appears right at the moment of the crack.
Tendons sliding over bone can click too.
Cracking without pain is common, even in healthy knees.
But cracking with pain or swelling? Get it checked.
Next time: what's that stabbing pain in your side when you run?
